content.text:
If you mean **free SiriusXM / satellite radio**, the legal options are limited:

1. **SiriusXM Free Access Plan** — SiriusXM has a free, ad-supported plan for some **eligible vehicles/radios**. No credit card, but it may not work on every car and usually doesn’t include app listening. ([siriusxm.com](https://www.siriusxm.com/plans/free-access?utm_source=openai))  
2. **SiriusXM free trial** — New or eligible users/vehicles can often get a free trial. Check the official SiriusXM trial page. ([siriusxm.com](https://www.siriusxm.com/free-trial?utm_source=openai))  
3. **Free Listening Events** — SiriusXM occasionally unlocks inactive car radios for a short promotional period. These come and go, so they aren’t always available.  
4. **Free alternatives that aren’t satellite** — If you just want free radio/music, use **FM/AM**, **HD Radio** if your car supports it, or free internet radio apps/sites like iHeart, TuneIn-style services, NPR, or web radio directories.

There generally isn’t a permanent “free satellite radio hack” that’s legal—SiriusXM’s main satellite service is subscription-based.
